title: Spectral dual-layer detector CT-based radiomics-deep learning for predicting pathological aggressiveness of stage I lung adenocarcinoma: discrimination of precursor glandular lesions and invasive adenocarcinomas.
summary: Dual-layer CT spectral features combined with radiomics/deep learning discriminated precursor glandular lesions from invasive stage I lung adenocarcinoma; the pathology-referenced cohort supports a diagnostic imaging result.
